title: RFC005 §30.3/§30.4 S2 Sampler Policy
$comment: Closed envelope for the intra-cell weight bounds the §30.3 decomposition is clamped by: `w_lineage = bounded(w_feature_coverage × w_hardness)` where `bounded` is this policy's per-factor min/max, applied ONLY inside the chosen StageDataMatrix cell (cross-cell reweighting is forbidden). All quantities are integer MILLI-units: the deterministic CBOR profile these hashes are computed under (`rfc8949-core-det-nfc-int-v0`) has no float in its data model, so a factor of 1.5 is `1500`, never `1.5`. `w_rare_cap_milli` is the §30.4 cap on `w_rare(f) = 1/sqrt(max(count_lineages(f), 1))`, which the producer expresses in per-mille (1.0 = 1000). `virtual_epoch_size` is the number of lineage-root draws one ordered exposure plan carries; the caps themselves live in the separate exposure policy (§30.6), which is a different policy artefact and must never be merged into this one.

stage_id.$comment: The S2 policy shape, reused by S3 (as S2) and by S4 with its own budget (owner 2026-09-21: 15 000 draws, 2 views); any other stage is a schema error rather than a silent cross-wire.

w_rare_cap_milli.$comment: §30.4: 'Presný cap je policy field'. Per-mille; the un-capped inverse-sqrt value is ≤ 1000 by construction, so a cap below 1000 is a legal tightening and one above 1000 is a declared ceiling the formula currently cannot reach.

virtual_epoch_size.$comment: One ordered exposure plan is one virtual epoch: exactly this many lineage-root draws, mass applied BEFORE fragment/view/augmentation expansion (§30.2).

bounds.$comment: Factor bounds in milli; `min ≤ max` is checked by the producer, which JSON Schema cannot express across fields.
